plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instruction replayed stale selectors that targeted the 'Solutions' dropdown button instead of 'Developers' due to a navbar DOM layout change on checklyhq.com. As a result, the test failed to navigate to '/docs/' and triggered an assertion mismatch at line 8.
observedIndicators: The page.ai runSource cache contained selector `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button`, which replayed onto `<button class="nav-item">Solutions</button>` instead of 'Developers'.
The failure screenshot shows the 'Solutions' dropdown menu expanded on the homepage, confirming the wrong menu was opened.
The assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` failed because page URL remained at `https://www.checklyhq.com/`.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai deterministic cache and re-run test.
remediationSteps.details: Clear the stale page.ai instruction cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai can identify the correct 'Developers' menu locator on the live DOM.

plan.notes: The header navigation layout on checklyhq.com changed, shifting element indices so that the cached selector `div:nth-of-type(2) > button` matched the 'Solutions' menu rather than 'Developers'. Clearing the page.ai cache will allow Donobu to autonomously re-inspect the live page DOM and generate working selectors.
